notes: Series is NASCAR, so the primary configuration is the 2.5-mile tri-oval superspeedway, NOT the infield road course. The oval has exactly 4 official turns, all banked at 31 degrees. The front stretch (the 'tri-oval' bend at start/finish) is banked at 18 degrees but is NOT counted as a numbered turn — it is the kink/dogleg of the tri-oval shape. Oval turns at Daytona are officially numbered (1-4) but have no proper names, so name=null for all. NASCAR ovals have NO official published timing sectors (no FIA-style sector timing on ovals), hence sector_count=null and sectors=[]. The track also has a 14-turn infield road course (Daytona Road Course) used for IMSA Rolex 24 and some NASCAR road races, but that is a separate configuration not described here since the series specified is NASCAR (oval). All apex coordinates are approximate, derived from the supplied track center (29.185, -81.07) and standard oval geometry; turn ordering follows NASCAR convention going counter-clockwise from the start/finish on the front tri-oval. Start/finish line position is approximate.
